_: The realm's market prices (prices.js; Anno's and Manor Lords' prices that follow supply, Victoria's goods that war makes dear): each good's base in gold, moved each season by what the realm lives through, each factor multiplying. grain: poorHarvest while a wet harvest's lean seasons last, winter, famine per share of the realm's towns starving (1 + famine x share), sickness while a plague walks the roads. iron: war per war between houses or a royal siege (1 + war x n, at most warMost). timber: siege per town under siege (1 + siege x n). cloth: blocked per share of towns whose trade is stopped (besieged, roads shut). Decrees cost their price times their good's rise (decrees: action -> good; treasury.js priceOf), so the treasury feels the market.
